subject: design/argus-attribution-hardening
statement: The gate evaluates authorship over the PR's own commit range (`base..HEAD`), so pre-mechanism history is never in range and never retroactively refused; the producer stamps every drive commit from the mechanism's landing forward, so no latent window remains; the mechanism's own introducing PR is the incident-I1 exception *(design-brainstorm:argus-attribution-hardening-tech-design#D-4; basis DOD-7, UB-5; incident I1)*.
